fact: UNSD reports that in 2022 consultants were brought in to support ANSD in setting up a modern IT system, with staff training to streamline data exchange, and that the infrastructure was fully operational by end 2022; a data-sharing mechanism for disaster data from 46 departments was planned for dissemination by January 2024.
title: The Data for Now initiative: Use of innovative methods, tools and data sources for more accurate, timely and granular Sustainable Development data
publisher: United Nations Statistical Commission, Background document, fifty-fourth session
